description: Clear English lessons, practical revision resources and reliable teaching support for O/L English, O/L and A/L Literature and General English, with past papers, interactive practice and RCF Online Academy.

hero.text: Clear English lessons, practical revision resources and reliable teaching support for learners and teachers. Everything is organised by subject and by task, so you can find what you need and start work straight away.

aside.title: Who this is for
items: **O/L and A/L students**, including private candidates preparing on their own
**Adults and independent learners** building everyday and working English
**Learners who need extra help**, with smaller steps and more guided practice
**Teachers and tuition teachers**, with lesson plans, worksheets and marking guides
**Parents**, who can see what is examined and what a good answer looks like
aside.footnote: Free to read, no account required. No tracking and no behavioural advertising. Paid educational listings are clearly marked Sponsored.

blocks.heading: Featured resources
intro: If you are not sure where to start, these are the pages students and teachers use most.

items.title: Guided Writing
text: The six-step method used throughout this site: understand, study a model, find the structure, practise with guidance, write alone, then correct.

items.title: How to Develop an Answer
text: Turn a one-line response into a full paragraph: point, evidence, explanation, effect and link.

items.title: Common Student Mistakes
text: The errors that cost marks most often in O/L English, with the correct form beside each one.

items.title: Examination Techniques
text: Reading the question, dividing your time, planning briefly and leaving time to check.

items.title: Interactive Practice
text: Grammar, vocabulary, reading and error-correction activities that mark themselves and explain the answer.

items.title: Slow-Learner Support

text: Match a word or a literary term to its meaning.

items.title: Error correction

blocks.heading: Our learning approach
intro: Every lesson on RCF English follows the same progression. It is deliberately gradual, because most learners fail at writing not through lack of ability but through lack of preparation.

items.title: Understand
text: Receive a clear explanation of the lesson or the task, in plain language.

items.title: Observe
text: Study a useful model and see exactly how it is put together.

items.title: Practise
text: Complete activities with guidance, one step at a time.

items.title: Apply
text: Use what you have learnt independently, without the model in front of you.

items.title: Review
text: Find your own mistakes with a checklist, correct them, and strengthen what you know.

blocks.heading: Featured courses
intro: Online classes conducted by Rohana Fernando. Schedules, fees and available places are confirmed on WhatsApp, so the information you receive is always current.

blocks.heading: About RCF English
text: RCF English is a comprehensive educational platform created to bring together English-language learning, literature education, examination support, teacher resources, online classes and educational publications in one accessible place.

It serves school students, O/L and A/L learners, adult learners, English teachers, tuition teachers and parents. Particular attention is given to learners who require additional guidance, including those in rural and remote areas with limited access to dependable educational resources.

The platform was founded by **Rohana Fernando**, an experienced English teacher and lecturer, a graduate in English of the University of Peradeniya with a Master of Arts in Linguistics from the University of Kelaniya and a TESOL qualification from the University of Peradeniya.
[Read the full About Us page](about/) or [meet the founder](about/founder/).
